draft_en.subject: Media converters under the Wirewerks label - next to the copper and fibre systems
draft_en.body:
Hi Carl,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 4 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the media converters offered under the Wirewerks label with your copper and fibre systems, in your packaging from small lots, FCC/CE/RoHS: industrial Gigabit converter, DIN-rail, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot (fixed SC optional), -40 to 75 C - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); a small 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP-uplink switch for the same closets - STC-28GM - $61.2; desktop converters on request.

One question: which converter configuration do your installer customers order most - SFP-slot or fixed SC?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
